senses.gloss:
mfn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं)
Disturbed in mind, confused, confounded.
m. (-ञ्जः)
Killing, slaughter.
n. (-ञ्जं)
Strength, power.
f. (-ञ्जा)
1 Hurting, injuring, injury.
2 Cotton.
3 Turmerick.
4 A sort of palm (?)
5 A switch.
E.
पिजि to hurt or kill, aff. अच्.

m. (-टः)
The concrete rheum of the eyes.
E.
पिजि to give pain, अटच् aff.

n. (-नं)
A bow used for cleaning cotton.
E.
पिजि to touch, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Yellow or tawny, reddish yellow.
m. (-रः)
A sort of colour, tawny brown, a reddish yellow, or a mixture of red and yellow.
2 A horse, probably a bay or chesnut horse.
n. (-रं)
1 Gold.
2 Yellow orpiment.
3 A cage.
4 The ribs or the cavity formed by them, the thorax: see पञ्जर.
E.
पिजि to dye or tinge, अरच् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Confounded, overcome with terror or grief.
m. (-लः)
An army panick-struck, or in great disorder.
n. (-लं)
1 The leaf of the Kuśa grass.
2 Yellow orpiment.
f. (-ली)
Two blades of Kusa grass, used as a vessel, or to take up articles with, at sacrifices.
E.
पिजि to hurt, &c. aff. अलच्.

f. (-का)
A roll of cotton, from which the threads are spun.
E.
पिञ्जा cotton, कन् added in the fem. form.

n. (-लं)
The wick of a lamp.
E.
पिजि to hurt, &c. Uṇādi aff. ऊलच्.

m. (-षः)
The wax of the ear.
E.
पिजि to stain, ऊष aff.

m. (-टः)
The excretion, or concrete rheum of the eyes.

f. (-ला)
The noise, or rustling of leaves.
